// Control fixture for the FreeBSD root-act scan: every shape below must be
// refused, and the comment inside the module must not count as an act.

#[cfg(any(target_os = "freebsd", test))]
pub(crate) enum Primitive {
    /// `jail(8)`.
    Jail,
    MountNullfs,
    Mount,
    Umount,
    Rctl,
    Owner,
}

#[cfg(any(target_os = "freebsd", test))]
impl Primitive {
    const fn spelling(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Jail => "/usr/sbin/jail",
            Self::MountNullfs => "/sbin/mount_nullfs",
            Self::Mount => "/sbin/mount",
            Self::Umount => "/sbin/umount",
            Self::Rctl => "/usr/bin/rctl",
            Self::Owner => "/usr/sbin/pw",
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(target_os = "freebsd")]
mod freebsd_jail {
    use std::process::Command as Run;
    use std::fs as files;
    use std::os::unix::fs::lchown;

    fn give_tree(tree: &Path, user_bin: &Path) {
        // Command::new(user_bin) and std::fs::canonicalize in a comment are no act.
        let _ = Run::new(user_bin).arg("nobody").arg(tree).status();
        let _ = std::process::Command::new(
            user_bin
        )
        .status();
        let _ = files::remove_dir(tree);
        let _ = std::fs::canonicalize(tree);
        let _ = std::os::unix::fs::chown(tree, Some(0), Some(0));
        let _ = lchown(tree, None, None);
        let _ = tree.symlink_metadata();
        let _ = libc::geteuid();
        let _ = resolve_primitive(Primitive::Owner);
        let label = "chown";
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new().spawn(|| ());
    }

    extern "C" {
        fn mount();
    }
}
